note.summary:
3.3 The environment and where people live
Key focus
- homes, towns, environmental problems, nature and sustainable action.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use conditional structures for solutions, comparative forms for places, and modal language for what people should do.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I live in a small town where there are lots of parks.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Abito in una città piccola dove ci sono molti parchi.”

Describe the place where the speaker lives.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Traffic causes noise and makes the air more polluted.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Il traffico causa rumore e rende l’aria più inquinata.”

Give two environmental problems caused by traffic.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Every week we separate paper, glass and plastic.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Ogni settimana separiamo carta, vetro e plastica.”

Which materials are separated, and how often?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: We planted twenty trees in the field behind the school.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Abbiamo piantato venti alberi nel campo dietro la scuola.”

What was planted, how many, and where?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: We should use the car less and cycle more often.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Dovremmo usare meno l’auto e prendere più spesso la bicicletta.”

Name two transport changes the speaker recommends.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: In the future my house will have solar panels on the roof.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“In futuro la mia casa avrà pannelli solari sul tetto.”

What environmental feature will the future house have?
